[LUNI.15.1] **A unit symbol resolves by one lookup.** The lexer produces a
`UNIT_SUFFIX` token opaquely, and the compiler must look its full symbol, or an
alias of it, up in the file's unit scope: `units.core` ([LUNI.4.1.2]), the units
the file imports, and the units it declares. A symbol found nowhere is a compile
error (`DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_UNIT`). A symbol bound twice is refused ([LIMP.5.1.5]), so the order of the
imports never decides what a literal means. `5_MHz` resolves because `units.si` declares `MHz` as
an alias of `megahertz`, and `5_molar` because `units.chemistry` declares
`molar`. A unit no imported module declares is the author's to declare.
